description: Scripted-fault fixture (Deliverable 3) for the retry layer. The form→results click times out on its first 2 triggers, then succeeds — so a payload with retry.maxAttempts >= 3 retries into success, while retry.maxAttempts <= 2 exhausts into a retryable-exhausted failure. The attempt count is per-transition on the session (resets with a fresh run).
